en.text: Starship is designed to make humanity multi-planetary. This is not optional — it's essential for our survival.
en.context: Articulating Starship's mission and the necessity of becoming multi-planetary

zh.text: Starship被设计为使人类成为多行星物种。这不是可选的——它对我们的生存至关重要。
zh.context: 阐述Starship的使命和人类成为多行星物种的必要性

en.text: Falcon 9 has landed for the 200th time. Reusability is what makes space travel affordable.

zh.text: Falcon 9第200次成功着陆。可复用性是让太空旅行变得负担得起的关键。
zh.context: 庆祝Falcon 9火箭第200次成功着陆回收

en.text: Starship will land humans on Mars. The first uncrewed mission will launch in the next window. Humans on Mars by 2029.

zh.text: Starship将把人类送上火星。第一次无人任务将在下一个窗口期发射。2029年人类登陆火星。
zh.context: 宣布火星任务时间线

en.text: The first Starship orbital flight attempt will happen soon. This is the biggest rocket ever built.
en.context: Previewing Starship's first orbital flight attempt

zh.text: 第一次Starship轨道飞行尝试即将发生。这是有史以来建造的最大火箭。
zh.context: 预告Starship首次轨道飞行尝试

en.text: Starship's first integrated flight test. Not perfect, but we learned a tremendous amount. Success comes from learning.
en.context: Comment after Starship's first test flight, which exploded but gathered data

zh.text: Starship的首次集成飞行测试。不完美，但我们学到了大量东西。成功来自学习。
zh.context: Starship首次试飞后的评论，虽然爆炸但获取了大量数据

en.text: Multi-planetary life is the ultimate goal. Earth is fragile. We need a backup.
en.context: Philosophical reflection on humanity becoming multi-planetary

zh.text: 多行星生命是终极目标。地球是脆弱的。我们需要一个备份。
zh.context: 关于人类需要成为多行星物种的哲学思考

en.text: Starship Flight Test 2 was a massive improvement over FT1. Rapid iteration is the key to progress.
en.context: Positive assessment after Starship's second test flight

zh.text: Starship第二次飞行测试比第一次有巨大改进。快速迭代是进步的关键。
zh.context: Starship第二次试飞后的积极评价

en.text: SpaceX has launched over 250 Falcon 9 missions. Each one gets us closer to Mars.

zh.text: SpaceX已执行超过250次Falcon 9任务。每一次都让我们离火星更近。
zh.context: SpaceX Falcon 9任务数量里程碑

en.text: Starship Flight Test 3 — we reached space for the first time! The Raptor engines performed beautifully.
en.context: Starship's third test flight successfully reached space

zh.text: Starship第三次飞行测试——我们首次到达太空！Raptor引擎表现完美。
zh.context: Starship第三次试飞成功到达太空

en.text: The Starship Super Heavy booster catch attempt with the tower arms is the hardest engineering challenge I've ever seen.
en.context: Describing the technical difficulty of Starship booster recovery

zh.text: 用塔臂捕获Starship Super Heavy助推器是我见过的最困难的工程挑战。
zh.context: 描述Starship助推器回收的技术难度

en.text: MEGA SUCCESS! Starship booster caught by the chopstick arms on first attempt! History made.
en.context: First successful Super Heavy booster catch by launch tower arms

zh.text: 巨大成功！Starship助推器在第一次尝试中就被筷子臂捕获！创造了历史。
zh.context: Starship Super Heavy助推器首次被发射塔机械臂成功捕获

en.text: Catching a rocket booster with robot arms is something straight out of science fiction. But we just did it.
en.context: Reflection on successfully catching the booster

zh.text: 用机械臂捕获火箭助推器，这简直就像科幻小说里的情节。但我们刚刚做到了。
zh.context: 对成功捕获助推器的感慨

en.text: Starship Flight Test 4 — both stages performed well. Super Heavy caught again. Ship made a controlled landing in the Indian Ocean.
en.context: Starship's fourth test flight fully successful

zh.text: Starship第四次飞行测试——两级都表现良好。Super Heavy再次被捕获。飞船在印度洋完成可控着陆。
zh.context: Starship第四次试飞全面成功

en.text: 55 years ago today, humans walked on the Moon. In 5 years, humans will walk on Mars. The future is now.
en.context: Apollo 11 moon landing 55th anniversary Mars outlook

zh.text: 55年前的今天，人类登上了月球。5年后，人类将登上火星。未来就是现在。
zh.context: 阿波罗11号登月55周年纪念日的火星展望

en.text: Starship Flight Test 5 — Super Heavy caught for the third time. Ship landed on target. Full reusability is within reach.
en.context: Starship's fifth test flight, reusability goal nearly achieved

zh.text: Starship第五次飞行测试——Super Heavy第三次被成功捕获。飞船精准着陆。完全可复用性近在咫尺。
zh.context: Starship第五次试飞，可复用性目标接近实现

en.text: SpaceX is now launching more mass to orbit than the rest of the world combined. By a lot.

zh.text: SpaceX现在向轨道运送的质量比世界其他国家的总和还多。而且是多得多。
zh.context: SpaceX发射能力里程碑

en.text: The first Starship cargo mission to Mars will launch in 2026. Uncrewed, but carrying supplies for future human missions.

zh.text: 第一次Starship火星货运任务将于2026年发射。无人，但携带未来载人任务的物资。
zh.context: 宣布2026年火星货运任务计划

en.text: Falcon 9 has now landed 300 times. Each landing saves millions of dollars. Reusability works.

zh.text: Falcon 9现已着陆300次。每次着陆节省数百万美元。可复用性是有效的。
zh.context: Falcon 9第300次着陆里程碑

en.text: Starship is now fully reusable. Both stages land and are reflown. This changes everything.

zh.text: Starship现在完全可复用了。两级都能着陆并重新飞行。这改变了一切。
zh.context: 宣布Starship实现完全可复用

en.text: Humans on Mars by 2029. That's the plan. The first crew will have the bravest people on Earth.

zh.text: 2029年人类登陆火星。这就是计划。第一批船员将是地球上最勇敢的人。
zh.context: 重申火星载人任务时间线

en.text: Starship can now carry 150 tons to low Earth orbit. That's more than any rocket in history.

zh.text: Starship现在可以向低地球轨道运送150吨载荷。这比历史上任何火箭都多。
zh.context: Starship载荷能力更新

en.text: The Raptor 3 engine produces 350 tons of thrust. It's the most efficient rocket engine ever made.

zh.text: Raptor 3引擎产生350吨推力。它是有史以来最高效的火箭引擎。
zh.context: Raptor 3引擎技术参数公布

en.text: SpaceX has launched over 400 missions total. The cadence is only going to increase.

zh.text: SpaceX总发射任务已超过400次。发射频率只会继续增加。
zh.context: SpaceX总发射次数里程碑

en.text: Starship has successfully completed its first orbital refueling test. Mars missions are now technically possible.
en.context: Starship orbital propellant transfer test success

zh.text: Starship成功完成了首次轨道加注测试。火星任务在技术上现在成为可能。
zh.context: Starship轨道推进剂转移测试成功

en.text: The Mars colony will start with a small group of pioneers. They will build the foundation for millions to follow.

zh.text: 火星殖民地将从一小群先驱者开始。他们将为数以百万计的后来者奠定基础。
zh.context: 描述火星殖民愿景

en.text: Starship Flight Test 10 — full reusability demonstrated for the 5th time. Routine is setting in.

zh.text: Starship第10次飞行测试——第5次展示完全可复用性。常规化正在形成。
zh.context: Starship可复用性已成为常规操作

en.text: The first Starships for the Mars mission are being built now. 2026 launch window is the target.

zh.text: 用于火星任务的第一批Starship正在建造中。2026年发射窗口是目标。
zh.context: 火星任务飞船建造进展

en.text: SpaceX Starlink now has over 10,000 satellites in orbit. The largest constellation ever built.

zh.text: SpaceX Starlink现在在轨卫星超过10000颗。有史以来建造的最大卫星星座。
zh.context: Starlink卫星数量里程碑

en.text: Mars. The red planet. Our second home. The window opens in 2026 and we will be ready.

zh.text: 火星。红色星球。我们的第二个家。窗口在2026年打开，我们将准备就绪。
zh.context: 火星任务倒计时

en.text: 2025 was a breakthrough year for Starship. Full reusability achieved. Mars architecture validated. 2026 will be even bigger.

zh.text: 2025年是Starship的突破之年。实现了完全可复用。火星架构得到验证。2026年将更加壮观。
zh.context: 年终总结Starship成就

en.text: The Mars cargo ships are being stacked at Starbase. This is really happening, folks.

zh.text: 火星货运飞船正在Starbase组装。这真的在发生，各位。
zh.context: 火星货运飞船组装进展

en.text: Starship has flown 50 times. The pace of progress is extraordinary. We went from explosions to routine orbital flights in 3 years.

zh.text: Starship已飞行50次。进步的速度非同寻常。我们在3年内从爆炸变成了常规轨道飞行。
zh.context: Starship第50次飞行里程碑

en.text: SpaceX is now the most valuable space company in the world. But valuation isn't what matters — making life multi-planetary does.
en.context: Commentary on SpaceX valuation vs mission

zh.text: SpaceX现在是世界上最有价值的太空公司。但估值不重要——让生命成为多行星的才重要。
zh.context: 关于SpaceX估值与使命的评论

en.text: The Mars 2026 window is approaching. We will send at least 5 Starships with cargo to the surface.

zh.text: 火星2026年窗口正在临近。我们将至少发送5艘Starship携带货物到火星表面。
zh.context: 2026年火星窗口任务详情

en.text: Falcon 9 has been the workhorse of space. But Starship will carry 100x the payload at 1/10th the cost.

zh.text: Falcon 9一直是太空的中坚力量。但Starship将以十分之一的成本运载100倍的载荷。
zh.context: 比较Falcon 9和Starship的能力

en.text: Humans will walk on Mars before the end of this decade. Mark my words.

zh.text: 在这个十年结束之前，人类将在火星上行走。记住我的话。
zh.context: 重申火星载人时间线

en.text: The cost per launch of Starship will eventually be under $10M. That's cheaper than some airplane flights.

zh.text: Starship每次发射的成本最终将低于1000万美元。这比一些飞机航班还便宜。
zh.context: 关于Starship发射成本的预测

en.text: Starship is the key to a self-sustaining city on Mars. Without it, we're stuck on Earth forever.
en.context: Emphasizing Starship's critical role in Mars colonization

zh.text: Starship是在火星上建立自维持城市的关键。没有它，我们将永远困在地球上。
zh.context: 强调Starship对火星殖民的关键作用

en.text: SpaceX's launch cadence is now over 100 missions per year. No other organization comes close.

zh.text: SpaceX的发射频率现在超过每年100次任务。没有其他组织能接近。
zh.context: SpaceX年发射频率里程碑

en.text: The first Mars cargo Starships will launch in the 2026 window. Humanity's journey to the stars begins now.
en.context: Official announcement of 2026 Mars cargo mission launch

zh.text: 第一批火星货运Starship将在2026年窗口发射。人类前往星辰的旅程从现在开始。
zh.context: 正式宣布2026年火星货运任务发射计划
